messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Sertraline carries a boxed warning, the FDA's most serious type of warning.
Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behavior in children, teenagers, and young adults in short-term studies.
Pooled analyses of placebo-controlled antidepressant trials were conducted.
The trials covered about 77,000 adults and more than 4,500 children and teenagers.
The risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in people aged 24 and under was higher with an antidepressant than with placebo.
The risk varied considerably between different antidepressants.
The risk also varied by condition.
The highest rate of risk was in people being treated for depression.
The difference between antidepressant and placebo, per 1,000 patients treated, was:
Age (years) | Difference compared with placebo
Under 18 | 14 more patients with suicidal thoughts or behaviors
18 to 24 | 5 more patients
25 to 64 | 1 fewer patient
65 and over | 6 fewer patients
It is not known whether this risk continues beyond about four months of treatment.
Triplet: ["Pooled analyses", "conducted of", "placebo-controlled antidepressant trials"]

The relation 'conducted of' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject action or study was conducted on or involving the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires': The subject condition requires the action or intervention specified by the object entity.
B. 'has participant': The study or trial specified by the subject entity includes the group or treatment specified by the object entity as a participant.
C. 'can cause': The subject entity may lead to or result in the condition or effect specified by the object entity.
D. 'include': The object entity is an example or member of the subject entity.
E. 'vary by': The subject entity differs depending on the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
